courses.overview: 由資源導向授權、政策決策與持續證據連結兩個已編寫的相鄰專業；相似方法不表示性能數值、權限或介面可以直接沿用。
courses.overviewEn: Connect resource-centric authorization, policy decisions and continuous evidence to two authored neighboring domains; shared methods do not make metrics, permissions or interfaces interchangeable.

related.title: 身分與存取管理
related.why: 可移植「資源盤點」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的身分與授權。
related.whyEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from resource inventory; both require traceable identities/permissions.
related.transfer: 可移植「資源盤點」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的身分與授權。
related.transferEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from resource inventory; both require traceable identities/permissions.
related.difference: 本課主要處理資源導向授權、政策決策與持續證據；「身分與存取管理」主要處理身分生命週期、聯邦與權限模型，其驗收指標及信任／物理邊界需重定義。
related.differenceEn: This course emphasizes resource-centric authorization, policy decisions and continuous evidence; Identity and access management emphasizes identity lifecycle, federation and authorization models. Redefine acceptance metrics and trust/physical boundaries.
practice: 並排畫出「企業零信任網路」與「身分與存取管理」的資料／元件流程，圈出可共用及不可共用的邊界。
移植本課「裝置證據」的對照方法至「角色模型」，重新指定輸入、單位與可觀測量。
重算兩課假想例，列出哪些參數無法直接沿用，並各寫一項拒絕與一項放行證據。
practiceEn: Draw Enterprise zero-trust networks and Identity and access management flows side by side and mark transferable/nontransferable boundaries.
Transfer the comparison method from device evidence to role models, redefining inputs, units and observations.
Recompute both hypothetical cases, identify parameters that cannot transfer and write one rejection/acceptance record per case.

related.title: 工控網路分區與隔離
related.why: 可移植「資源盤點」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的身分與授權。
related.whyEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from resource inventory; both require traceable identities/permissions.
related.transfer: 可移植「資源盤點」的邊界辨識、對照資料與證據方法；兩課都需要可追溯的身分與授權。
related.transferEn: Transfer boundary identification, controlled records and evidence methods from resource inventory; both require traceable identities/permissions.
related.difference: 本課主要處理資源導向授權、政策決策與持續證據；「工控網路分區與隔離」主要處理OT 區域、通道與不中斷的防禦證據，其驗收指標及信任／物理邊界需重定義。
related.differenceEn: This course emphasizes resource-centric authorization, policy decisions and continuous evidence; Industrial-control network segmentation emphasizes ot zones, conduits and non-disruptive defensive evidence. Redefine acceptance metrics and trust/physical boundaries.
practice: 並排畫出「企業零信任網路」與「工控網路分區與隔離」的資料／元件流程，圈出可共用及不可共用的邊界。
移植本課「裝置證據」的對照方法至「流矩陣」，重新指定輸入、單位與可觀測量。
重算兩課假想例，列出哪些參數無法直接沿用，並各寫一項拒絕與一項放行證據。
practiceEn: Draw Enterprise zero-trust networks and Industrial-control network segmentation flows side by side and mark transferable/nontransferable boundaries.
Transfer the comparison method from device evidence to flow matrices, redefining inputs, units and observations.
Recompute both hypothetical cases, identify parameters that cannot transfer and write one rejection/acceptance record per case.
